title.narrative: Realizing Human rights through Media and Legal Reforms
Realizing Human rights through Media and Legal Reforms

description.narrative: Development challenges/ problems the project will address: Restrictive laws and regulations that limit media freedom, hostile environment of Journalists and other human rights defenders in Tanzania Project beneficiaries: The project will work with both mainstream journalists as well as citizen journalists. These will include journalists, media owners, bloggers, social media influencers, editors, citizen journalists, media managers in Tanzania mainland Project results • An Increase in realizing freedom of the media and protection of journalists in Tanzania through influencing policy processes and monitoring government action. • Improve the legal framework towards realization of human rights for Human Rights Defenders in Tanzania by enhancing service delivery to vulnerable groups. The project will be implemented by Media Institute of Southern Africa Tanzania chapter (MISA-TAN) in collaboration with Protection International Africa (PIA) and other likeminded NGOs such as Legal and Human Rights Centre (LHRC) The organization was selected through call for the proposal and they fitted in the criteria as announced during the call: e.g. legally registered, they have sound financial management and internal control system, they have relevant policies to guide the organization, they have human resources and infrastructures, and they have experiences working on the theme and international donors, statuary compliances. Link to website: https://tanzania.misa.org/
